IMS and Copernicus inputs must be reacquired from official providers. Raw IMS observations are not redistributed; derived national IMS series are shipped with attribution (see DATA_RIGHTS.md). Live products never replace frozen publication inputs.

```{r}
library(SIECCLongWeather)
suppressWarnings(download_live_sources(dry_run = TRUE))
```
